objects.name: HPE security advisory (AV26-727)
objects.description: Include was a critical update for the following: HPE Aruba Networking Private 5G Core – versions 1.26.1.1 and prior HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect SD-WAN Gateways – multiple versions and platforms The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply the necessary updates. HPESBNW05083 rev.1 - Private 5G Core, Traefik StripPrefix Route-Level Auth Bypass via Path Normalization (CVE-2026-48020) HPESBNW05013 rev.1 - HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect SD-WAN Gateways, Multiple Vulnerabilities HPE Security Bulletin Library
